title: How to Crop a GIF on iPhone: Square, Portrait or Wide
description: Crop a video into a square, portrait or wide GIF on iPhone. Pick the right shape for chats, Discord, Slack and READMEs, and get a smaller file as a bonus.
h1: How to crop a GIF on iPhone
card_summary: Square, portrait or wide: crop before converting for sharper, smaller GIFs.
quick_answer: Crop the video before it becomes a GIF: in Make Video to GIF choose an aspect preset (for example square) in the crop step, frame the subject, then set FPS and loop and convert. Cropping a GIF that already exists re-encodes it and loses quality, so start from the original video whenever you have it.
intro: Phone videos are tall; chat bubbles, Discord embeds and READMEs are not. A crop puts the subject in the middle of the frame and removes the pixels nobody looks at.
Cropping is also the second-biggest file size saving after trimming, so a well-cropped GIF is both easier to read and faster to load.

sections.heading: Crop versus resize
paragraphs: Cropping removes the edges; resizing shrinks everything, including text and faces. For GIFs of interfaces or anything with text, crop instead of resizing so details stay sharp.

steps.heading: Step by step: crop a video into a GIF
steps.intro: Works the same for any shape.

items.name: Open the video
items.text: Pick the clip in Make Video to GIF.

items.name: Choose an aspect preset
items.text: Select the shape, for example square, and position the frame over the subject.

items.name: Set FPS and loop
items.text: Adjust them in GIF settings and check the estimated size.

items.name: Convert
items.text: Tap Convert to GIF and share it.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Leave a little space around a face; tight crops look cramped when the head moves.
For screen recordings, crop out the status bar and home indicator.
If the subject moves across the frame, use a wider crop rather than cutting it off mid-loop.

faq.question: Can I crop a GIF without the original video?
faq.answer: Yes, but re-encoding a GIF loses quality. Use the original video when you can.

faq.question: Does cropping make a GIF smaller?
faq.answer: Yes. Fewer pixels per frame means a smaller file; a square crop of a widescreen clip removes almost half of each frame.

faq.question: What size should a Discord GIF be?
faq.answer: A square or wide crop a few hundred pixels across looks sharp in chat and stays well under the 20 MB free limit.
